title: lane-history.jsonl record
description: JSON Schema for the JSON object portion of a single record in out/lane-history.jsonl. The file is append-only; each record is one JSON object terminated by a newline and followed by a per-record CRC32 footer line per v3.3-architecture.md §6.5. This schema validates the JSON object only; the CRC footer line is validated separately by the reader-side verifier and by scripts/validate_lane_history.py. Field names and per-kind required-field sets mirror the §6.5 prose verbatim so the post-merge audit ordering rule, the state_recovery successor rule, and the digest_emit Carried Debt predicate can be evaluated mechanically against records of this schema.

ts.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp with millisecond precision (e.g. 2026-05-10T14:23:45.123Z).

lane_id.description: Identifier of the lane this event belongs to. cycle_boundary events emitted by the global cycle clock use lane_id: lane-cycle-clock.

kind.description: Event kind discriminator. MUST match v3.3/enums/lane-history-kinds.txt exactly; the schema-drift validator (Phase 1) fails the commit if this enum diverges from that file or from §6.5 prose.

plan_sha.description: sha256 of the lane-plan.yaml at lane-open time. A second lane_open for the same lane_id is L4.

pr.description: GitHub PR number. 0 means 'branch created, gh pr create not yet succeeded'; updated to the real PR number by a follow-up pr_open with the same branch.

blocker_pr.description: Required if kind_of_pivot is deferred-on-dependency; absent otherwise.

override.description: null means no override invoked; a non-null string is the operator-override justification. bhs_official < 100 requires a non-null override.

merge_sha.description: SHA returned by gh pr merge step 4 in §10.8; the post-merge confirm-state step verifies this equals mergeCommit.oid.

cause.description: <namespace>:<suffix>. Namespace MUST appear in v3.3/enums/lane-pause-causes.txt; plan_fault suffixes MUST appear in v3.3/enums/plan-faults.txt. Per-namespace suffix sets for non-plan_fault namespaces are enumerated in the §6.5 lane_pause row prose and cross-checked by scripts/validate_v33_schema_drift.py.

last_event_index.description: Line index into lane-history.jsonl that this lane_pause event occupies. Referenced by lane_history_ref fields in out/carried-debt.jsonl cd_open records when the pause was a merge_authority:post_merge_invariant_violated event.

paused_at_event_index.description: MUST match the last_event_index of the prior lane_pause event being resumed. A lane_resume without a matching prior lane_pause is L4.

phase_alignment_path.description: Path to the phase-alignment.md artifact produced at this boundary per §6.6.

aggregate_smoke_exit.description: Exit code from the phase-boundary aggregate smoke run. Non-zero requires the next event be either a lane_pause with cause: plan_fault:aggregate_smoke_nonzero or a pivot.

carried_debt_ids_written.description: Every cd_id appended to out/carried-debt.jsonl since the previous digest_emit. The §6.5 digest_emit row's Carried Debt predicate operates on this field; an unsatisfied predicate is L5 and the reader-side verifier refuses to advance.

recovery_reason.description: MUST match v3.3/enums/state-recovery-reasons.txt. post_merge_drift_detected is the only legal recovery_reason for a state_recovery whose immediately prior event is a lane_pause with cause merge_authority:post_merge_invariant_violated.

cycle_id.description: UUIDv7 unique across all cycle_boundary events. Per v3.3/tables/cycle-clock.yaml, this id is the target_cycle_id of every cd_tick record in the batch that follows.

preceding_cycle_id.description: cycle_id of the immediately prior cycle_boundary, or null for the first cycle in the lane-history.

trigger.description: MUST match the three approved triggers in v3.3/tables/cycle-clock.yaml. min_cycle_interval_seconds (default 3600) is enforced by the writer per cycle-clock.yaml.
